name: browser-mcp
description: Drive your real, signed-in Chrome from any AI agent. When it hits a 2FA code, a CAPTCHA or a choice only you can make, it asks on your screen and carries on in the same tab.
long_description:
Browser MCP gives your agent the Chrome you already use - your sessions, your cookies, your logins - instead of a fresh headless browser that hits a login wall on the first page. 43 tools.

IMPORTANT - this is half of Browser MCP. The other half is a Chrome extension, and Chrome does not allow an extension to be installed automatically. Without it the server sits on "Not connected" forever.

Install the standalone extension via 'browser-mcp install' into ~/.browser-mcp/extension and load unpacked under chrome://extensions.

Nothing is sent to us: the extension talks to a server on 127.0.0.1 that you started. No account, no telemetry, no API key. MIT.
